items.source: Execution will end once the scheduler shuts down or the returned ScheduledFuture gets cancelled.
items.translation: 执行将在调度器关闭或返回的ScheduledFuture被取消时结束。

items.source: task - the Runnable to execute whenever the trigger fires
items.translation: task - 每次触发器触发时执行的 Runnable。

items.source:
The bean name for this router, or the bean name of the containing
bean if the router instance is internally held.
items.translation: 此路由器的 Bean 名称，或者如果路由器实例由内部持有，则为包含 Bean 的 Bean 名称。

items.source: startTime - the desired first execution time for the task (if this is in the past, the task will be executed immediately, i.e. as soon as possible)
items.translation: startTime - 任务的期望首次执行时间（如果该时间在当前之前，任务将立即执行，即尽可能早地执行）

items.source: period - the interval between successive executions of the task
items.translation: period - 任务连续执行之间的间隔

items.source: delay - the delay between the completion of one execution and the start of the next
items.translation: delay - 一次执行完成与下一次开始之间的延迟时间

items.source: A routing implementation of the TaskScheduler interface, delegating to a target scheduler based on an identified qualifier or using a default scheduler otherwise.
items.translation: 一个 `TaskScheduler` 接口的路由实现，它会根据识别到的限定符委托给目标调度器，否则使用默认调度器。

items.source: The default name of the TaskScheduler bean to pick up: "taskScheduler".
items.translation: 默认名称为 `TaskScheduler` 的 Bean，用于拾取："taskScheduler"。

items.source: Schedule the given Runnable, invoking it at the specified execution time.
items.translation: 调度给定的 Runnable，在指定的执行时间调用它。

items.source: Schedule the given Runnable, invoking it whenever the trigger indicates a next execution time.
items.translation: 调度给定的 Runnable，每当触发器指示下一个执行时间时调用它。

items.source: Schedule the given Runnable, starting as soon as possible and invoking it with the given period.
items.translation: 安排给定的 Runnable，尽快开始并以其给定周期进行调用。

items.source: Schedule the given Runnable, invoking it at the specified execution time and subsequently with the given period.
items.translation: 调度给定的 Runnable，在指定的执行时间调用它，随后以给定的周期进行调用。

items.source: Schedule the given Runnable, starting as soon as possible and invoking it with the given delay between the completion of one execution and the start of the next.
items.translation: 调度给定的 Runnable，尽可能早地开始执行，并在每次执行完成与下一次启动之间使用给定的延迟间隔。

items.source: Schedule the given Runnable, invoking it at the specified execution time and subsequently with the given delay between the completion of one execution and the start of the next.
items.translation: 调度给定的 Runnable，在指定的执行时间调用它，随后以给定的延迟间隔，在一次执行完成和下一次启动之间重复调用。

items.source: a ScheduledFuture representing pending execution of the task, or null if the given Trigger object never fires (i.e. returns null from Trigger.nextExecution(TriggerContext))
items.translation: 一个代表任务待执行状态的ScheduledFuture，或者如果给定的 Trigger 对象从未触发（即从Trigger.nextExecution(TriggerContext)返回null），则为null。

items.source: trigger - an implementation of the Trigger interface, for example, a CronTrigger object wrapping a cron expression
items.translation: trigger - 一个实现了Trigger接口的实现，例如一个包装了 cron 表达式的CronTrigger对象

items.source: name - the name of the bean in the factory. Note that this name is the actual bean name used in the factory, which may differ from the originally specified name: in particular for inner bean names, the actual bean name might have been made unique through appending "#..." suffixes. Use the BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String) method to extract the original bean name (without suffix), if desired.
items.translation: name - 工厂中 Bean 的名称。 请注意，此名称是工厂中实际使用的 Bean 名称，可能与最初指定的名称不同：特别是对于内部 Bean 名称，实际的 Bean 名称可能已通过追加"#..."后缀使其唯一化。如需提取原始 Bean 名称（不带后缀），请使用BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String)方法。

items.source: beanFactory - owning BeanFactory (never null). The bean can immediately call methods on the factory.
